attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Rewrites the core DefaultDocumentSerializer (used to persist shell/site documents across all tenants) plus base64 decoding logic used in password-reset and media import paths with new span/stream-based buffer-pooled code, so any subtle off-by-one or disposal bug in the new Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream-based logic could corrupt or break document persistence or auth tokens platform-wide."}

reason: Rewrites the core DefaultDocumentSerializer (used to persist shell/site documents across all tenants) plus base64 decoding logic used in password-reset and media import paths with new span/stream-based buffer-pooled code, so any subtle off-by-one or disposal bug in the new Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream-based logic could corrupt or break document persistence or auth tokens platform-wide.
